title: Important things to know if you subscribe through Amazon.
text:
If you subscribe through amazon.

1. it's easier to sign up and cancel.
2. Everything in the box must adhere to Amazons code of conduct, and thus some item will be different (inferior) to the ones in a regular batlbox.
3. Because of Amazons policy, Battle box must ship on the exact first day of the shipping window. To implement this you don't' get "this months" battlbox.You get whatever battle box they have handy, this months, last months 4 months ago (that's what i got) and there is no guarantee you will not get the same box twice. (took me about a week of repeatedly asking to get this answer)

for me #3 was the killer so i canceled through amazon and signed up straight through battlbox.
label: neutral
